notes: The complete file header and GRCh37 coordinates are verified. Original rows were cross-checked against the Catalog's standardized file: original A1 equals standardized effect_allele and original BETA equals standardized beta for the inspected variants. The paper states upstream INFO >=0.60 and MAF >=0.005 QC; the released file does not carry INFO, so the QC ledger must retain that source-level limitation.

The complete 11,284,768-row file was inspected. Its explicit effect_allele/beta fields are selected; I2 is a heterogeneity statistic, not INFO. EBI states that the data were filtered to I2 <65%. No per-variant frequency, INFO, or sample-size field is present, so those source limitations must remain explicit in the QC ledger.

The complete 7,884,164-row file was inspected. The source provides both odds_ratio and beta; beta is selected because the EBI README explicitly identifies effect_allele as the allele for beta. No INFO or per-variant sample-size field is present, so those source limitations must remain explicit in the QC ledger.

The complete 20,170,208-row file was decompressed and inspected. FinnGen R9 documentation defines alt as the effect allele, beta as log(OR) for alt, and the coordinates as GRCh38. No per-variant INFO or sample-size field is present; archive-level variant annotation is separate. The source must be lifted over and revalidated before hg19 harmonization.
